abstract: OBJECTIVE: To clarify the role of Rho small GTP-binding protein (Rho) in the progression of testicular germ cell tumour (GCT), by examining the expression levels of mRNAs of Rho genes in testicular GCT. PATIENTS AND METHODS: The mRNA levels of the RhoA, RhoB and RhoC genes were analysed in the surgical specimens of testicular GCT tissues from 45 consecutive Japanese patients, and in the corresponding unaffected tissue originating from the same patient, using reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction. The expression levels in tumour tissues were compared with those in unaffected tissues and the relationship between their expression levels in tumours and tumour stage evaluated. The expression levels of mRNAs of the Rho genes were also evaluated between tumours with seminoma only, and mixed tumours with seminoma and nonseminoma. RESULTS: The mRNA levels of RhoA were greater in tumour tissues than in unaffected tissues of the resected testis (P < 0.01); the mRNAs of RhoB and RhoC were not detected in either tissue. The increase in RhoA mRNA levels was related to tumour stage (P < 0.05). The mRNA levels of RhoA in seminomatous and nonseminomatous areas where both were present were higher than those in tumours with seminoma only (P < 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: These results suggest that RhoA is involved in testicular germinal epithelial carcinogenesis and progression in testicular GCT, indicating that RhoA may be a useful prognostic marker for progression in testicular GCT.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）の進行におけるRho低分子量GTP結合タンパク質（Rho）の役割を明らかにするため、精巣GCTにおけるRhoファミリー遺伝子のmRNA発現量を検討する。患者と方法：日本人患者45例の連続症例から、精巣GCTの手術検体および同一患者の非病変精巣組織について、逆転写ポリメラーゼ連鎖反応（RT-PCR）でRhoA、RhoB、RhoCの遺伝子mRNA量を解析した。腫瘍組織と非病変組織の発現量を比較し、腫瘍内の発現量と腫瘍病期との関係を評価した。また、セミノーマ単独の腫瘍と、セミノーマと非セミノーマが混在する腫瘍との間でRho遺伝子のmRNA量を比較した。結果：RhoAのmRNA量は非病変精巣組織よりも腫瘍組織で高かった（P<0.01）。RhoBおよびRhoCのmRNAは両組織のいずれでも検出されなかった。RhoAのmRNA量の増加は腫瘍病期と関連していた（P<0.05）。セミノーマと非セミノーマが共存する領域のRhoAのmRNA量は、セミノーマ単独の腫瘍より高かった（P<0.05）。結論：RhoAは精巣胚細胞の上皮性発がんおよび精巣GCTの進行に関与していることが示唆された。RhoAは精巣GCTの進行の有用な予後マーカーとなりうる。
